active_ingredients.name: Chlorothalonil
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Multi-site contact (chloronitrile, FRAC M05) — inhibits multiple fungal enzymes/respiration; protectant, low resistance risk.

active_ingredients.name: Pyraclostrobin
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: QoI strobilurin (FRAC 11) — inhibits mitochondrial respiration at complex III (cyt bc1, Qo site); single-site, high resistance risk.

active_ingredients.name: Streptomycin sulfate
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Aminoglycoside antibiotic (FRAC 25) — inhibits bacterial protein synthesis via the 30S ribosome.

active_ingredients.name: Oxytetracycline
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Tetracycline antibiotic (FRAC 41) — inhibits bacterial protein synthesis at the 30S ribosome.

active_ingredients.name: Kasugamycin
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Aminoglycoside antibiotic (FRAC 24) — inhibits bacterial protein synthesis.

active_ingredients.name: Acibenzolar-S-methyl
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Host plant defense inducer (FRAC P01) — primes systemic acquired resistance; no direct antimicrobial action.

active_ingredients.name: Permethrin
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Pyrethroid (IRAC 3A) — prolongs sodium-channel opening, disrupting nerve function; contact.

active_ingredients.name: Bifenthrin
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Pyrethroid (IRAC 3A) — sodium-channel modulator causing nerve hyperexcitation; contact/residual.

active_ingredients.name: Zeta-cypermethrin
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Pyrethroid (IRAC 3A) — sodium-channel modulator; contact/residual.

active_ingredients.name: Bacillus thuringiensis kurstaki
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Microbial (IRAC 11A) — Bt Cry endotoxins rupture the caterpillar midgut membrane; stomach poison, larvae only.

active_ingredients.name: Paraffinic oil
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Horticultural mineral oil — smothers soft-bodied pests and eggs; physical suffocant, unclassified (IRAC UN).

active_ingredients.name: Kaolin clay
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Particle-film barrier — mineral coating deters feeding and egg-laying; mechanical action, unclassified (IRAC UN).

active_ingredients.name: Imidacloprid
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Neonicotinoid (IRAC 4A) — competitive modulator of nicotinic acetylcholine receptors; systemic.

active_ingredients.name: Lambda-cyhalothrin + Boscalid + Pyraclostrobin
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Premix — pyrethroid Na-channel modulator (IRAC 3A) + SDHI complex-II inhibitor (FRAC 7) + QoI complex-III inhibitor (FRAC 11).

active_ingredients.name: Glyphosate
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: EPSP-synthase inhibitor (HRAC 9) — blocks the shikimate pathway; non-selective systemic.

active_ingredients.name: Glufosinate
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Glutamine-synthetase inhibitor (HRAC 10) — ammonia buildup; non-selective contact.

active_ingredients.name: Pelargonic acid
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Fatty-acid contact (HRAC 17) — disrupts cell membranes/cuticle for rapid desiccation; non-selective burndown.

active_ingredients.name: Pendimethalin
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Microtubule-assembly inhibitor (dinitroaniline, HRAC 3) — blocks seedling cell division; pre-emergent.

active_ingredients.name: Flumioxazin
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: PPO inhibitor (HRAC 14) — blocks protoporphyrinogen oxidase, causing membrane peroxidation; pre/early-post.

active_ingredients.name: Indaziflam
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Cellulose-biosynthesis inhibitor (HRAC 29) — pre-emergent with long residual.

active_ingredients.name: Non-ionic surfactant
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Spray adjuvant — lowers surface tension to improve wetting/coverage; no pesticidal mode of action (unclassified).

active_ingredients.name: Pinolene
active_ingredients.mode_of_action: Spreader-sticker adjuvant (di-1-p-menthene) — forms a film that cuts runoff and evaporation; no pesticidal mode of action.

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: Broccoli, Cabbage: Alternaria Leaf Spot, Downy Mildew. Begin prior to disease development, 7-10 day intervals. Higher rates when conditions favor disease.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: Max 12.8 lb product (9.6 lb ai)/acre/crop. Max 6 apps at high rate, 8 at low rate. PHI 7 days.

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: Cranberries only: Fruit Rot. Begin at early bloom, repeat 7-10 day intervals. Max 19.2 lb product/acre/season. Note: Mancozeb is NOT labeled for blueberries, strawberries, blackberries, or raspberries on this label.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: PHI 30 days. Max 3 apps at high rate, 6 at low rate. Cranberries only.

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: Downy Mildew, Phytophthora Blight/Crown Rot. 7-14 day intervals. Do not make more than 2 sequential apps before rotating to non-Group 11 fungicide. Do NOT use on muskmelon/cantaloupe/honeydew with additives/adjuvants. Do NOT tank mix with Malathion, Kelthane, Thiodan, Phaser, Lannate, Lorsban, M-Pede, or Botran.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: Max 104 oz/acre/season. Not for greenhouse/transplant production.

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: Fruiting Vegetables (Pepper, Eggplant, Tomatillo): PHI 0 days. Anthracnose, Alternaria, Cercospora, Downy mildew, Early blight, Late blight, Septoria, suppression of Phytophthora blight. 7-14 day intervals. Tomato: PHI 4 days. Same diseases plus black mold, target spot. Potato: PHI 4 days. Alternaria, black dot, early blight, late blight. For late blight: max 1 sequential app before rotating.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: Max 130 oz/acre/season. Not for greenhouse/transplant production. For late blight, rotate after 1 app; for other diseases, rotate after 2 sequential apps.

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: Bulb Vegetables (Garlic, Leek, Onion, Shallot): Downy Mildew, Alternaria purple blotch. 14-day intervals. Max 2 sequential apps before rotating to non-Group 11.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: Max 130 oz/acre/season.

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: Apple Fire Blight: 24-48 oz/A (50-100 ppm at 600 gal/A). First application at 20-30% bloom. Spray every 3-4 days during blossom time. After petal fall, continue at 10-14 day intervals for twig blight (could be 6-8 additional apps). PHI 50 days. Pear Fire Blight (except CA): same rates/timing. PHI 30 days. Pear (CA only): 28.8 oz/A (60 ppm), first at 10% bloom, repeat 5-day intervals until late bloom over, then 5-7 day intervals for shoot/fruit infections. PHI 30 days.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: Apple PHI 50 days. Pear PHI 30 days. Do not exceed 2 sequential apps. For ornamental/landscape use (100 ppm), do not apply after fruit is visible.

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: Tomato and Pepper SEEDLINGS/TRANSPLANTS ONLY: 200 ppm (0.5-1 lb in 50-100 gal/A). Bacterial Spot, Bacterial Speck. Apply first spray at 2-leaf stage, continue 4-5 day intervals until transplanted in field. NOT for field production on mature plants.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: Seedling/transplant treatment only, not for field spray program. Not registered for bacterial speck in California.

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: Apple/Pear: codling moth 1-3 qt/A, most pests 1.5-3 qt/A, white apple leafhopper 0.5-1.5 qt/A. Max 15 qt/acre/crop/year, max 8 apps. On apples, avoid full bloom to 30 days after unless thinning desired. Apple thinning: 2-6 pints/A between 80% petal fall and 16mm fruit size. Do not use on pears tight flower cluster to 20mm fruit size. Do not apply to quince.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: PHI 3 days. REI 12 hours. Do not apply to crops in bloom (BEE CAUTION). Mow weed/cover crop bloom before applying.

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: Apricot, Cherry, Nectarine, Peach, Plum, Prune. Most pests 2-3 qt/A. Dormant/delayed dormant with oil: 4-5 qt/A (max 5 qt/A at dormant timing). Max 14 qt/acre/crop/year total (5 dormant + 9 production). Production season: max 3 qt/A per application (non-CA), max 4 qt/A (CA only). Max 3 apps during production plus 1 dormant app.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: PHI 3 days (1 day in CA). Do not apply to crops in bloom (BEE CAUTION). Mow weed/cover crop bloom before applying.

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: Caneberries, Bushberries, Cranberries, Strawberries: 1-2 qt/A for most pests. Blueberry maggot, cherry fruitworm, cranberry pests: 1.5-2 qt/A. Grape berry moth, eight-spotted forester, cutworms: 2 qt/A. Max 10 qt/acre/crop/year, max 5 apps. Carbaryl may injure Early Dawn and Sunrise strawberry varieties.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: PHI 7 days. REI 12 hours for caneberries/bushberries/cranberries/strawberries. Do not apply to crops in bloom (BEE CAUTION).

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: Grape leaffolder, grape leafroller, grape berry moth, Japanese beetle, leafhoppers, etc. 1-2 qt/A. Apply before first brood larvae emerge from rolls. Do not concentrate spray on the bunch or visible residues may result.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: PHI 7 days. REI 2 days (East, except 6 days for grape girdling/cane turning), 6 days (West). Max 10 qt/acre/crop/year. Do not apply to crops in bloom.

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: Pickleworm, melonworm 0.5-1 qt/A. Cucumber beetles, flea beetles, squash bugs 1 qt/A. For squash bugs, time for early morning or late afternoon, sufficient spray volume.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: Max 6 qt/acre/crop/year. Observe plant response precautions. Do not apply to crops in bloom (BEE CAUTION).

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: Tomato, Pepper, Eggplant: Colorado potato beetle, European corn borer, tomato fruitworm/hornworm, stink bugs (suppression), flea beetles 0.5-1 qt/A, most pests 1-2 qt/A, cutworms 2 qt/A. Max 8 qt/acre/crop/year, max 7 apps. Thorough coverage essential for stink bug suppression.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: PHI 3 days. Do not apply to crops in bloom (BEE CAUTION).

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: Lettuce, Spinach, Endive, Parsley, Celery, etc. Flea beetles/leafhoppers 0.5-1 qt/A. Armyworm, cabbageworm, stink bugs 1-2 qt/A.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: Max 6 qt/acre/crop/year. PHI 14 days. Do not apply to crops in bloom (BEE CAUTION).

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: Broccoli, Brussels sprouts, Cabbage, Cauliflower, Kale, Kohlrabi, Turnip greens, etc. Flea beetles/harlequin bug/leafhoppers 0.5-1 qt/A. Armyworm, cabbageworm, diamondback moth, stink bugs 1-2 qt/A. Application permitted only within 30 days from crop emergence/transplanting.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: Head/Stem Brassica 5A: PHI 3 days. Leafy Brassica 5B: PHI 14 days. Max 6 qt/acre/crop/year. Do not apply to crops in bloom (BEE CAUTION).

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: Snap beans, peas, soybeans, etc. Bean leaf beetle, Mexican bean beetle 0.5-1 qt/A, corn earworm 0.5-1.5 qt/A, armyworm/cutworms/stink bugs 1-1.5 qt/A. Use on succulent shelled peas and beans (Crop Subgroup 6B) is prohibited.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: Fresh edible-podded beans/peas: PHI 3 days. Dried beans/peas/seed/hay: PHI 21 days. Forage: PHI 14 days. Max 6 qt/acre/crop/year. Do not apply to crops in bloom (except soybeans). Do not combine with 2,4-DB herbicides on soybeans.

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: Potato, Carrot, Beet, Radish, Turnip, etc. (except sugar beet and sweet potato). Flea beetles/leafhoppers 0.5-1 qt/A, Colorado potato beetle/corn earworm/cutworms/armyworm 1-2 qt/A.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: Max 6 qt/acre/crop/year. PHI 7 days. Do not apply to crops in bloom (BEE CAUTION).

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: DIRECTED SPRAY ONLY — do not contact crop foliage. Spot spray rate: 1.7 fl oz/gal. Requires AMS adjuvant (17 lb/100 gal).
crop_uses.restrictions_text: Non-selective contact herbicide. Max 3 applications per 12-month period. Add ammonium sulfate for best performance.

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: DIRECTED SPRAY ONLY — contact burndown herbicide. Do not contact desirable foliage. Apply to actively growing weeds for best results.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: Non-selective contact herbicide. No soil residual. Repeat applications needed for perennial weeds. Can be tank-mixed with glyphosate for systemic + contact action.

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: PRE-EMERGENT — soil-applied, NOT a foliar spray. Apply to weed-free soil in late winter/early spring before weed emergence. Requires rainfall or irrigation to activate.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: Do not apply to newly planted trees/vines (< 1 year). Established orchards only. Max 4.2 qt/acre/year for pome/stone fruit.

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: PRE-EMERGENT — soil-applied. Apply to clean, weed-free soil. Best applied late fall through early spring before bud break. Do not apply after bud break or green tissue is present.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: Do not apply to trees/vines established less than 1 year. Avoid contact with foliage or green bark — causes severe tissue burn.

crop_uses.growth_stage_restrictions: PRE-EMERGENT — soil-applied. Apply once per year, late winter/early spring. Provides 6-8 months residual weed control. Requires moisture to activate.
crop_uses.restrictions_text: Established plantings only (3+ years). Do NOT use on young trees. Extremely long soil residual — do not replant treated area for 36 months. Do not exceed 5 fl oz/acre/year.
